Pradeep Kumar Srivastava
--------
For the Appellant : Mr. K.S. Nanda, Advocate For the State : Ms. Anuradha Sahay, A.P.P.
--------

Order No. 06/ Dated: 03rd November, 2025 I.A. No. 13549 of 2025 Heard Mr. K.S. Nanda, learned counsel for the appellant and learned A.P.P. appearing for the State.
2.
This application has been preferred by the appellant for grant of bail to him during the pendency of this appeal.
3. The appellant has been convicted for the offences under Section 376(2)(g) & 366A of the IPC and has been sentenced to undergo R.I. for 10 years.
4. It has been alleged that the daughter of the informant had gone to answer the call of nature but she did not return back her home.
Search was conducted but she could not be traced out.
5. Submission has been advanced by the learned counsel for the appellant that the appellant is in custody for more than five years.
It has further been submitted that the evidence of the witnesses does not indicate that it was the appellant who had subjected the victim to rape.
6. Learned APP appearing for the State has opposed the prayer for bail of the appellant and has submitted that the appellant has remained in custody for about 4 years 3 months.

sentences.text: It appears that the victim has been examined as P.W.-5 and she has categorially stated about the commission of rape by the appellant and the medical report corroborates the said fact.

It also appears that the appellant had absconded for 21 years and on consideration of the entire facets of the case, we are not inclined to admit the appellant on bail and the prayer for bail of the appellant is hereby rejected, at this stage.
8. The aforesaid I.A. stands disposed of.
( Rongon Mukhopadhyay, J.) (Pradeep Kumar Srivastava, J.)
